l

You can modify event R720 (reference check for reconnection) in the Standard function module table (which can be found in
Customizing for Financial Accounting (Fl)) via the program enhancement for contract accounts receivable and payable. This
enables you to perform an amount check. You can find a reference for the program enhancement in the
ISU_CECK_RECONNETION_R720 function module (trigger reconnection upon clearing).

Create reconnection order

Reconnection orders are created for disconnected devices and flat-rate installations in the same way that disconnection orders are
created.

You also specify whether you need to contact the corresponding customer ( Notification ) before you carry out the actual device
reconnection.

If notification is required, the system generates a notification work item . The CRM agent assigned to this work item must contact
the customer, set an agreed date and close the work item before the reconnection order can be processed further

If notification is not required, or if the notification work item is closed, you can continue processing the reconnection order

You can also generate a corresponding service management (SM) service order (note however, that if notification is required, the
system can only generate service orders after you have set the agreed date and the notification work item is closed).

Enter reconnection and confirm reconnection order

Following reconnection, you enter the reconnection data in the system. You can also generate a customer contact, adjust the
budget billing plan, post charges, and enter meter readings for the reconnection.

Disconnection Document Release

Use

Using the release mechanism, an agent can explicitly release disconnection documents before actual disconnection and
reconnection processing. You cannot carry out further steps with the disconnection document (for example, generating a
disconnection order) until the disconnection document is released.

In this way, you can control the workload of field service employees, for example by releasing disconnection documents according
